rows.claim: The indexer is still running and still writing, so bad data may still be getting in.
rows.evidence: Status output shows the indexer healthy=true, maintenance=false, replicas=2, so it is running and not in maintenance. No tool output shows whether it is actually writing data, or that bad data is entering. The "still writing" part is inferred from maintenance being off, not observed. The "may" hedge covers only the bad-data part.
